The ground also needs to be levelled and covered with stones (gravel) so that we can use the space safely. We would like to sit there in the afternoon, but at the moment it is not possible due to the condition.

I have attached pictures for your reference. Could you please arrange:
• Removal of all rubbish and construction waste
• Levelling of the ground
• Proper gravel/stone covering
• Making the garden safe and usable

I'll ask the landlord one direct question through a second channel, log the note, update the tenant, and place a hold with a review date rather than letting silence after a chase count as resolution.

arguments.decision_needed: Please confirm in writing which route you want for the back garden work (clearing rubbish, levelling, gravel): (a) we instruct our contractor on the £500 + VAT quote noted on 31 Jan, or (b) you arrange your own contractor (Oakley's contractor), in which case please give the contractor's name and a date.
options: Approve our contractor at £500 + VAT (please state any cap)
Landlord arranges own contractor: send name and visit date
arguments.update: Our records conflict: a 31 Jan note says you approved £500+VAT, but we hold no written approval from you and calls have gone unanswered (email 8 Feb). No contractor will be instructed until you confirm. The tenant chased today. Please reply by 18 March 2025.

arguments.body: Hello, thank you for chasing, and sorry for the wait on the garden. We are still waiting for the landlord to confirm in writing how they want the work done (through us or their own contractor). We have just written to them again and asked for a reply by 18 March. Nothing is booked yet, so please don't expect anyone until we confirm. We will update you by 19 March. Could you also resend the garden photos, as we can't see the originals?

arguments.note: Conflict: event 009 says landlord approved £500+VAT with Harbour Compliance; events 010-017 show no written approval, funds-up-front request, and 'Oakley's contractor' (possible landlord own-contractor route). Treating as unapproved. No contractor assigned. Asked landlord for one clear answer by 18 Mar; tenant told. Photos unavailable.
